title: DE/F4: .crosslink/keys/ absent from the instance — the installed environment expects it; add path-only entry
description: Evidence: the draft instance records identity-state entries for agent.json and driver-key.pub but omits .crosslink/keys/ (the agent keypair directory the chassis creates at agent init; referenced by agent.json's ssh_key_path field). It is part of the installed environment (per-clone, chassis-runtime source, never tracked — inner .crosslink/.gitignore covers it) and its absence with an agent.json present is a broken-identity state the substrate check should name. Fix: add a path-only entry (class identity-state, resolution exists; NO key material, comments, or fingerprints in the manifest — the identity/privacy rule). Security coordination flag: trust-boundary artifact enumeration in a tracked file is paths-only by design; Security's lens confirms at the set's review round. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: security.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Resolved: keys/ entry added, path-only, paired with identity-agent; no key material in the manifest. Evidence: commit fdbc3dc3 (mdatron verify clean at commit time), vsdd-cli #658 trail.
